main_measure.name: mean next-day unusual move (long, drift removed), day-pooled t

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day pooled

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 cases; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: upper-half minus lower-half mean unusual move, split at median low_close post_pipeline_value

decided_by: Mean unusual move above 0 with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases, and the upper-half minus lower-half difference is positive.
reading: Situation checked as range/close over the std (ddof 1) of the last 30 in-window daily returns >= 2 and close location from the high >= 0.75 (recorded raw value, else from prices), using the location alone on the first bars of a window where 30 returns are not yet available, profile vetoes not re-checked; cases are long-side forecast rises of >= 2 points from the lowest level since the last bet, and the supporting split puts cases strictly above the median post_pipeline_value in the upper half, the rest in the lower half.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.001001 on the check folds against +0.008414 on every fold
